execution_evidence: All 47 tests pass with the Lua script implementation. The old pipeline 'add-then-remove' pattern has been replaced with an atomic Lua script that: (1) only adds entries when under limit, (2) eliminates the race condition window, (3) reduces Redis round-trips from 2 to 1. Key validations: zrem is no longer called outside the script, pipeline is no longer used, eval is called once per check, concurrent 35-request test correctly allows 30 and denies 5 without any zrem calls.

[Green] 只调用一次 eval 完成全部检查 (从2次往返减少到1次)
[Green] 并发请求不存在竞态窗口 (Lua 脚本原子执行)
